finding_before: A cited evidence text saying "7 t CO2e/year" allowed the answer "The annual estimate is 7." because the numeric token matched and the answer contained no unit claim to compare.

change.behavior: When a numeric answer token matches one or more unit-bearing claims in cited evidence, at least one matching value+unit claim must appear in the answer. Existing unit allowlist and exact lexical unit comparison remain unchanged.
change.regression: tests/rag-vercel-api.cjs rejects the unitless answer and continues to accept the same value with the cited t CO2e/year unit.

verification.result: passed: Vercel RAG checks passed (Gemini request contract works; public route stays closed).

limitations: Only unit forms in the current lexical allowlist are compared.
This does not establish semantic entailment, metric identity, period/boundary equivalence, or unit conversion.
No independent Thai user acceptance was performed.
